extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-format biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare an NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel or other significant contributors, following the required sections, table fields, and a five-page limit. Includes Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Contribution to Science, Education/Training, and Research Support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use this format for each person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the same set of labeled sections and fields (NAME, eRA COMMONS USER NAME, POSITION TITLE, EDUCATION/TRAINING, A. Personal Statement, B. Positions and Honors, C. Contribution to Science, D. Additional Information: Research Support) for every individual listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page limit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The biographical sketch for each person must be five pages maximum. All sections combined must fit within this limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Header required fields
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, eRA Commons username (or other credential/login as specified), and current position title at the top of the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rows with INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), END DATE MM/YYYY, and FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with the undergraduate/baccalaureate entry and include subsequent training (residency, fellowship, postdoctoral). Add or delete rows to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement describing the individual's research focus, relevant expertise, and mentoring/qualification history (e.g., track record of mentoring, prior awards) that justify their role on the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize current research focus and relevant prior work that makes the person well suited for the proposed role. Include evidence of mentorship experience, relevant awards (e.g., K08), and specific technical/disciplinary expertise. Tailor the statement to explain how the candidate's background supports their contribution to the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: List Positions and Employment and Honors and Awards with dates and brief context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a chronological list of positions/employment with years (e.g., 1993 - 1993: Project Associate...), followed by a list of honors and awards with dates and awarding organization. Include relevant service roles (e.g., study sections) and editorial/organizational roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative descriptions of key scientific contributions, each supported by selected publications (labeled a., b., c., etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each major contribution, provide a concise paragraph describing the scientific advance (what was discovered, its significance, and context), followed by 3–4 representative citations (with journal, year, PMID/PMCID where available). Use this section to highlight most important accomplishments and give evidence via selected publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Additional Information: Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: List Ongoing Research Support and Completed Research Support with project identifiers, funding source, project title, dates, role, and short description/objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each grant or support entry include grant number (e.g., R01 CA215461), sponsor (e.g., NCI/NIH), project title, project period (dates), individual's role (e.g., PI, Project Leader, Subcontract Young Investigator), and a one- or two-sentence description of objectives/aims. Separate ongoing and completed support and indicate status/dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete publication listing link
rubrics_metrics.description: Include link to complete list of published work in My Bibliography when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optionally (or by example), provide a URL to the individual's NIH My Bibliography or equivalent complete publication list (e.g., https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/myncbi/…/bibliography/public/) to supplement selected citations in the Contribution to Science section.
